## PRACTICAL APPLICATIONS

## ATTENTIONAL FOCUS AND MUSCLE HYPERTROPHY

Attentional focus is a well-recognized aspect of motor learning and its use has important implications for muscular hypertrophy. Operationally defined from a resistance training standpoint, attentional focus refers to what a person thinks about during each repetition. Two primary types of attentional focus have been recognized in the literature: internal and external. An internal focus involves thinking about bodily movements during performance, whereas an external focus involves thinking about the outcomes of movements.
